text: Built to that shape. map.json is things, links and flags, and every link carries a check that `kit.py map --check` reruns (2,565 on ~/french, all passing). Code is the first reader, so M4 can add Power BI or documents as another reader with the same output. M2 and M3 can call `kit.py map` and `--check` as they are. Probes for things only a browser sees are not built yet. Details are in the post under 'Where this sits in your design'.
